pages.title: Decor Blossom
pages.description: Decor Blossoms will  create  Prestidigitation  particles at a  wireless location.  To set the  particles, cast  Prestidigitation on  the block. Then use  the Dominion Wand to  set the desired  location. Casting  Dispel will remove  the particles, while
using the dominion  wand while sneaking  will remove the  location and  particles.
